subject: Vendor intake: missing tax info blocking PO issuance + spend cap adjustment
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Pierce <emma.pierce@starlane.io>, procurement@starlane.io
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor intake: missing tax id preventing PO issuance / provisional PO request

Hi Emma / Starlane intake team,

Thanks for submitting the vendor onboarding packet. I reviewed the forms and we're missing the vendor tax ID (line 12 on the onboarding PDF) and the bank details we need to attach to the supplier record. Without those two fields we can't mint a permanent PO number or wire payments.

Two asks so we don't block the onboarding:
- Can you send the tax ID + bank stub (or company letter) as a reply to this thread?
- If you need to start provisioning capacity immediately, we can issue a provisional PO number tied to a short-term spend cap (30k) while we finalize documentation. I need procurement + finance signoff for the provisional PO.

I've attached the latest onboarding_form_v2.pdf with the missing fields highlighted. Also call out if any SKU-level corrections are needed on the prospective purchase order (we noticed three SKUs with quantity mismatches compared to the intake sheet).

If you can get the tax ID by EOD Monday we should be able to finalize the permanent PO within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachment: onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

-----
From: Emma Pierce <emma.pierce@starlane.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@starlane.io
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: missing tax id preventing PO issuance / provisional PO request

Hi Monica,

Apologies — that was my oversight. Tax ID is 12-3456789; attached is our bank stub and a signed W9.

We would appreciate a provisional PO if possible. Our initial onboarding spend is expected to be ~18k in the first month, but a 30k cap sounds fine to give us headroom while the contract finishes signing.

I've attached bank_proof_starlane.pdf and w9_starlane_signed.pdf. Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Emma Pierce
Finance Manager, Starlane Inc.
emma.pierce@starlane.io
Attachment: bank_proof_starlane.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: w9_starlane_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

-----
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: missing tax id preventing PO issuance / provisional PO request

Monica — quick read on the attachments Emma sent. Tax ID and bank proof look valid. Two items we need to clear before issuing a provisional PO:

1) Spend cap: Recommend provisional PO with 30,000 USD ceiling for 30 days. After 30 days, either a permanent PO will be issued or we put the vendor on a temporary hold until accounting signs the contract.
2) Line-item corrections: The intake sheet shows SKU A123 qty 10 but the procurement request has qty 6, and SKU B557 is missing the color variant suffix. I created a short corrections sheet (po_line_corrections.xlsx) that proposes:
   - A123 -> split into A123-1 (qty 4) and A123-2 (qty 6) to match warehouse packing;
   - B557 -> B557-RED (qty 2) and B557-BLK (qty 3) – the red/black split was lost in translation.

If procurement approves, I'll have finance generate a provisional PO number P-2026-78421-PROV and push to the vendor portal. Karthik — can you confirm this doesn't conflict with any spend commit in the HubSpot deal (DL-78421)?

Thanks,
David
Billing & Systems 
Attachment: po_line_corrections.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: missing tax id preventing PO issuance / provisional PO request

David — I pulled the HubSpot record for DL-78421. Sales has a $50k committed value but only $12k invoiced so far. Issuing a provisional PO for 30k is acceptable as long as we flag the HubSpot deal with the provisional PO number and set the spend reason to "onboarding pilot". Also we should set an alert for the CS/AM owner so they know this is provisional spend and will need to be reconciled in the renewal.

I approve the line-item corrections you proposed; they match the packing constraints the warehouse team flagged last week.

Karthik
Director, Customer Success Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

-----
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Pierce <emma.pierce@starlane.io>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: missing tax id preventing PO issuance / provisional PO request

Thanks everyone — good catch on the SKU splits. David, please generate provisional PO P-2026-78421-PROV with a 30,000 USD spend cap and 30-day expiration. Route the PO to procurement@starlane.io and cc Emma. Karthik, please add a HubSpot note to DL-78421 with the provisional PO number and tag the AM (Anita Ramos) for reconciliation at renewal.

Emma — once the provisional PO is pushed, please confirm receipt in the vendor portal and accept the PO terms. After that we will circulate the DocuSign link for the permanent agreement. I placed the DocuSign prep link in related_links for your convenience.

I'll file the onboarding bundle to the supplier folder and mark this as "provisional-active." If any further line-item adjustments are required after vendor acceptance, open a procurement ticket and attach the updated SKU file.

Thanks,
Monica
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

-----
For audit: Action items created
- [PROC-1129] Issue provisional PO P-2026-78421-PROV (owner: David Kim)
- [PROC-1130] Add HubSpot note DL-78421 + tag AM (owner: Karthik Iyer)
- [PROC-1131] Vendor to confirm PO receipt in portal (owner: Starlane / Emma Pierce)
